title: 惠民理财
music: rural Chinese drama underscore, erhu, pipa, plucked strings, rising tension, mid tempo, instrumental, no vocals
logline: The village chief lures everyone into a 300% 'farm finance' app; Xiaokang calls it a scam, the whole village turns on him, and he washes his hands of them.

clips.summary: Under {loc}, a crowd gathers round village chief {fugui}, who holds up his phone and announces great news.
clips.soundscape: Outdoor village ambience under a big tree: a murmuring crowd, cicadas, wind in the leaves.

cuts.composition: Medium shot of {fugui} standing in the middle of a crowd of unnamed villagers under the great locust tree at {loc}, holding up {phone_app}.
cuts.action: {fugui} raises the phone high above his head; the crowd presses in.
cuts.camera: Slow push in, with small amplitude.

cuts.speaker: fugui
cuts.line: 各位乡亲！今天叫大伙来，是有个天大的好事！
cuts.say: 各位乡亲！今天叫大伙来……是有个天大的好事！
cuts.composition: Close-up of {fugui}, off-centre, a crowd of unnamed villagers under the great locust tree behind, soft and out of focus.
cuts.action: {fugui} waves the phone, gold tooth flashing.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.speaker: fugui
cuts.line: 我上个月投了五万块钱进去，你们猜怎么着？
cuts.say: 我上个月投了五万块钱进去……你们猜怎么着？
cuts.composition: Close-up of {fugui}, off-centre, a crowd of unnamed villagers under the great locust tree behind, soft and out of focus.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {cunmin}, centre frame, the background soft.
cuts.camera: Static camera.

cuts.speaker: fugui
cuts.line: 这才二十天，已经变成六万八了！
cuts.say: 这才二十天……已经变成六万八了！
cuts.composition: Close-up of {fugui}, off-centre, a crowd of unnamed villagers under the great locust tree behind, soft and out of focus.
cuts.action: {fugui} turns the phone screen to the crowd.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {cunfu}, centre frame, the background soft.
cuts.camera: Static camera.

clips.summary: The crowd erupts; {cunmin} and {cunfu} can't believe it; {fugui} swears he has never lied and shows the withdrawal record.
clips.soundscape: Outdoor village ambience under a big tree: a murmuring crowd, cicadas, wind in the leaves.

cuts.speaker: cunmin
cuts.line: 二十天赚一万八？这是真的假的？
cuts.say: 二十天赚一万八？这是……真的假的？
cuts.composition: Close-up of {cunmin}, off-centre, a crowd of unnamed villagers under the great locust tree behind, soft and out of focus.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.speaker: cunfu
cuts.line: 村长你可别哄俺们！
cuts.say: 村长……你可别哄俺们！
cuts.composition: Close-up of {cunfu}, off-centre, a crowd of unnamed villagers under the great locust tree behind, soft and out of focus.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.speaker: fugui
cuts.line: 我哄你们干啥？我当了十几年村长，什么时候骗过大家？
cuts.say: 我哄你们干啥？我当了十几年村长……什么时候骗过大家？
cuts.composition: Close-up of {fugui}, off-centre, a crowd of unnamed villagers under the great locust tree behind, soft and out of focus.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.speaker: fugui
cuts.line: 你们看，这是提现记录！
cuts.say: 你们看……这是提现记录！
cuts.composition: Close-up of {fugui}, off-centre, a crowd of unnamed villagers under the great locust tree behind, soft and out of focus.
cuts.action: {fugui} swipes on the phone and holds it out.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.speaker: cunmin
cuts.line: 还真能提出来！
cuts.say: 还真能……提出来！
cuts.composition: Close-up of {cunmin}, off-centre, a crowd of unnamed villagers under the great locust tree behind, soft and out of focus.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

clips.summary: {fugui} pitches a 300% 'rural benefit' finance plan; {dahua} pushes out of the crowd to invest her family's 100,000.
clips.soundscape: Outdoor village ambience under a big tree: a murmuring crowd, cicadas, wind in the leaves.

cuts.speaker: fugui
cuts.line: 这是专门面向农村的惠民理财，年化收益百分之三百！
cuts.say: 这是专门面向农村的惠民理财……年化收益百分之三百！
cuts.composition: Close-up of {fugui}, off-centre, a crowd of unnamed villagers under the great locust tree behind, soft and out of focus.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.speaker: fugui
cuts.line: 投十万，一个月就是近三万的利息啊！
cuts.say: 投十万……一个月就是近三万的利息啊！
cuts.composition: Close-up of {fugui}, off-centre, a crowd of unnamed villagers under the great locust tree behind, soft and out of focus.
cuts.action: {fugui} jabs the air with the phone.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {dahua}, centre frame, the background soft.
cuts.camera: Static camera.

cuts.speaker: dahua
cuts.line: 村长，我投！我家存折上正好有十万！
cuts.say: 村长，我投！我家存折上……正好有十万！
cuts.act: 从人群中挤出来，抢着喊
cuts.composition: Close-up of {dahua}, off-centre, a crowd of unnamed villagers under the great locust tree behind, soft and out of focus.
cuts.action: {dahua} elbows her way to the front.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

clips.summary: {cunfu} shouts thirty thousand; {xiaokang} pushes in and says it doesn't feel right; {dahua} sneers that he is a fly that lands on every good thing.
clips.soundscape: Outdoor village ambience under a big tree: a murmuring crowd, cicadas, wind in the leaves.

cuts.speaker: cunfu
cuts.line: 我投三万！
cuts.say: 我投三万！
cuts.composition: Close-up of {cunfu}, off-centre, a crowd of unnamed villagers under the great locust tree behind, soft and out of focus.
cuts.action: {cunfu} waves her phone in the air.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.composition: Medium shot of {xiaokang} shouldering through the edge of the crowd at {loc}.
cuts.action: {xiaokang} pushes his way into the crowd, frowning.
cuts.camera: Slow push in, with small amplitude.

cuts.speaker: xiaokang
cuts.line: 等等！大家听我说，这件事有点不靠谱！
cuts.say: 等等！大家听我说……这件事有点不靠谱！
cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang}, off-centre, a crowd of unnamed villagers under the great locust tree behind, soft and out of focus.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.speaker: dahua
cuts.line: 李小康，你是属苍蝇的吗？哪儿有好事你就往哪儿叮！
cuts.say: 李小康，你是属苍蝇的吗？哪儿有好事……你就往哪儿叮！
cuts.composition: Close-up of {dahua}, off-centre, a crowd of unnamed villagers under the great locust tree behind, soft and out of focus.
cuts.action: {dahua} turns, her face darkening, and sneers.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

clips.summary: {xiaokang} asks how any plan can pay hundreds of times a bank's interest; {fugui}'s smile freezes and he asks if he is being accused.
clips.soundscape: Outdoor village ambience under a big tree: a murmuring crowd, cicadas, wind in the leaves.

cuts.speaker: xiaokang
cuts.line: 村长，银行定期才不到百分之三，
cuts.say: 村长，银行定期……才不到百分之三，
cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang}, off-centre, a crowd of unnamed villagers under the great locust tree behind, soft and out of focus.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.speaker: xiaokang
cuts.line: 你这什么项目能有几百倍的收益？
cuts.say: 你这什么项目……能有几百倍的收益？
cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang}, off-centre, a crowd of unnamed villagers under the great locust tree behind, soft and out of focus.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {fugui}, centre frame, the background soft.
cuts.camera: Static camera.

cuts.speaker: fugui
cuts.line: 小康啊，听你这意思，你是在怀疑我骗乡亲们？
cuts.say: 小康啊……听你这意思，你是在怀疑我骗乡亲们？
cuts.composition: {xiaokang}'s shoulder blurs in the left foreground; {fugui} faces the camera in the right third.
cuts.camera: Static camera, focus held on the speaker's eyes.

clips.summary: Old {erdaye} tries to smooth things over; {fugui} turns cold; {erdaye} quietly tells {xiaokang} to apologise.
clips.soundscape: Outdoor village ambience under a big tree: a murmuring crowd, cicadas, wind in the leaves.

cuts.speaker: erdaye
cuts.line: 小康不是那个意思……
cuts.say: 小康不是那个意思……
cuts.composition: Close-up of {erdaye}, off-centre, a crowd of unnamed villagers under the great locust tree behind, soft and out of focus.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.speaker: fugui
cuts.line: 不是那个意思，那是什么意思？
cuts.say: 不是那个意思……那是什么意思？
cuts.composition: Close-up of {fugui}, off-centre, a crowd of unnamed villagers under the great locust tree behind, soft and out of focus.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.composition: Extreme close-up of {erdaye}'s cane striking the packed dirt.
cuts.action: The cane taps the ground once.
cuts.camera: Static camera.
cuts.sound: The cane thumps on the dirt.

cuts.speaker: erdaye
cuts.line: 这孩子……快给村长道歉。
cuts.say: 这孩子……快给村长道歉。
cuts.composition: Close-up of {erdaye}, off-centre, a crowd of unnamed villagers under the great locust tree behind, soft and out of focus.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.speaker: xiaokang
cuts.line: 我没错，我为什么要给他道歉！
cuts.say: 我没错……我为什么要给他道歉！
cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang}, off-centre, a crowd of unnamed villagers under the great locust tree behind, soft and out of focus.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {erdaye}, centre frame, the background soft.
cuts.camera: Static camera.

clips.summary: {dahua} shrieks that the chief works day and night for the village and accuses {xiaokang} of sour grapes; {cunmin} piles on.
clips.soundscape: Outdoor village ambience under a big tree: a murmuring crowd, cicadas, wind in the leaves.

cuts.speaker: dahua
cuts.line: 好你个李小康，在你眼里我们就都有问题是不是？
cuts.say: 好你个李小康！在你眼里……我们就都有问题是不是？
cuts.composition: Close-up of {dahua}, off-centre, a crowd of unnamed villagers under the great locust tree behind, soft and out of focus.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.speaker: dahua
cuts.line: 你眼看自己的计划没得逞，着急了？
cuts.say: 你眼看自己的计划没得逞……着急了？
cuts.composition: Close-up of {dahua}, off-centre, a crowd of unnamed villagers under the great locust tree behind, soft and out of focus.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang}, centre frame, the background soft.
cuts.camera: Static camera.

cuts.speaker: cunmin
cuts.line: 自己没本事赚钱，还看不得别人发财！你爸是怎么教你的？
cuts.say: 自己没本事赚钱，还看不得别人发财！你爸……是怎么教你的？
cuts.composition: Close-up of {cunmin}, off-centre, a crowd of unnamed villagers under the great locust tree behind, soft and out of focus.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang}, centre frame, the background soft.
cuts.action: {xiaokang} flinches at the mention of his father.
cuts.camera: Static camera.

clips.summary: {dahua} jabs a finger at his nose: he only sells broken corn; {cunfu} calls him stupid and wicked; the jeers grow.
clips.soundscape: Outdoor village ambience under a big tree: a murmuring crowd, cicadas, wind in the leaves.

cuts.speaker: dahua
cuts.line: 村长给咱们拉来这么大的项目，你呢？就知道卖那些破玉米！
cuts.say: 村长给咱们拉来这么大的项目……你呢？就知道卖那些破玉米！
cuts.composition: {xiaokang}'s shoulder blurs in the right foreground; {dahua} faces the camera in the left third, her finger thrust forward.
cuts.action: {dahua} steps up and points at his nose.
cuts.camera: Static camera, focus held on the speaker's eyes.

cuts.speaker: dahua
cuts.line: 照你这死脑筋，我们几百年才能发财！
cuts.say: 照你这死脑筋……我们几百年才能发财！
cuts.composition: Close-up of {dahua}, off-centre, a crowd of unnamed villagers under the great locust tree behind, soft and out of focus.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.speaker: cunfu
cuts.line: 又蠢又坏，说的就是李小康这种人！
cuts.say: 又蠢又坏……说的就是李小康这种人！
cuts.composition: Close-up of {cunfu}, off-centre, a crowd of unnamed villagers under the great locust tree behind, soft and out of focus.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.composition: Extreme close-up of {xiaokang}'s hand clenching into a fist at his side.
cuts.action: His knuckles whiten as the jeers rise.
cuts.camera: Static camera.

clips.summary: {xiaokang}'s inner voice: last year he sold the village's unsold corn, and the chief took the credit; what chills him is {dahua} knows it.
clips.soundscape: Outdoor village ambience under a big tree: a murmuring crowd, cicadas, wind in the leaves.

cuts.speaker: xiaokang
cuts.line: 去年玉米滞销，是我求爷爷告奶奶卖出去的，到头来功劳全算在了富贵头上。
cuts.say: 去年玉米滞销……是我求爷爷告奶奶卖出去的。到头来，功劳全算在了富贵头上。
cuts.act: 压抑着委屈的内心独白
cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang} in the jeering crowd, eyes red, jaw clenched.
cuts.action: The crowd mouths insults around him, unheard; {xiaokang} stares at {dahua}.

cuts.speaker: xiaokang
cuts.line: 最让我寒心的是，王大花明明都知道。
cuts.say: 最让我寒心的是……王大花明明都知道。
cuts.composition: Close-up of {dahua} laughing with the crowd, as {xiaokang} sees her.

clips.summary: {dahua} calls a show of hands for following the chief; everyone raises a hand, even old {erdaye}, slowly.
clips.soundscape: Outdoor village ambience under a big tree: a murmuring crowd, cicadas, wind in the leaves.

cuts.speaker: dahua
cuts.line: 咱们村没你更好！想跟着村长发财的，举手！
cuts.say: 咱们村没你更好！想跟着村长发财的……举手！
cuts.composition: Close-up of {dahua}, off-centre, a crowd of unnamed villagers under the great locust tree behind, soft and out of focus.
cuts.action: {dahua} thrusts her own hand into the air.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.composition: Medium shot under the great locust tree at {loc}: {dahua} stands in the centre, her own hand high, as a forest of unnamed villagers' hands shoots up around her.
cuts.action: Hands go up all around; {dahua} grins triumphantly.
cuts.camera: Slow push in, with small amplitude.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {erdaye}, the raised hands of the crowd around him.
cuts.action: {erdaye} glances around timidly, then slowly, shakily raises his hand.
cuts.camera: Slow push in, with small amplitude.

cuts.speaker: xiaokang
cuts.line: 二大爷！怎么你也不相信我？
cuts.say: 二大爷！怎么……你也不相信我？
cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang}, off-centre, a crowd of unnamed villagers under the great locust tree behind, soft and out of focus.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {erdaye}, centre frame, the background soft.
cuts.camera: Static camera.

clips.summary: {cunmin} and {cunfu} mock him; {xiaokang}, eyes red, swears he will never meddle in their affairs again.
clips.soundscape: Outdoor village ambience under a big tree: a murmuring crowd, cicadas, wind in the leaves.

cuts.speaker: cunmin
cuts.line: 切，傻子才信你呢，我跟着村长！
cuts.say: 切……傻子才信你呢，我跟着村长！
cuts.composition: Close-up of {cunmin}, off-centre, a crowd of unnamed villagers under the great locust tree behind, soft and out of focus.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.speaker: cunfu
cuts.line: 以前种玉米那是没办法，傻子才种玉米呢！
cuts.say: 以前种玉米那是没办法……傻子才种玉米呢！
cuts.composition: Close-up of {cunfu}, off-centre, a crowd of unnamed villagers under the great locust tree behind, soft and out of focus.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.speaker: xiaokang
cuts.line: 我的心彻底凉了。
cuts.say: 我的心……彻底凉了。
cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang}, centre frame, the crowd blurred.

cuts.speaker: xiaokang
cuts.line: 好，从今以后，你们的事我李小康不会再管了！
cuts.say: 好……从今以后，你们的事，我李小康不会再管了！
cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang}, off-centre, a crowd of unnamed villagers under the great locust tree behind, soft and out of focus.
cuts.action: {xiaokang} turns his back on the crowd.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.
